mapper.sql: s.id, s.workspace_id, s.family, s.subject_type, s.subject_id, s.subject_label, s.priority, s.priority_rank, s.rank_value, s.dedupe_key, s.evidence_json, s.rank_explanation_json, s.evidence_as_of, s.source_state_hash, s.generation_token, s.version, s.resolved_at, st.disposition, st.snooze_until, st.dismissed_source_hash, CASE WHEN st.task_source_hash = s.source_state_hash AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = s.workspace_id AND t.id = st.task_id ) THEN st.task_id ELSE NULL END AS task_id, st.task_source_hash, st.version AS state_version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO relationship_signal ( workspace_id, family, subject_type, subject_id, subject_label, priority, priority_rank, rank_value, dedupe_key, evidence_json, rank_explanation_json, evidence_as_of, source_state_hash, generation_token ) VALUES ( #{workspaceId}, #{family}, #{subjectType}, #{subjectId}, #{subjectLabel}, #{priority}, #{priorityRank}, #{rankValue}, #{dedupeKey}, CAST(#{evidenceJson} AS JSON), CAST(#{rankExplanationJson} AS JSON), #{evidenceAsOf}, #{sourceStateHash}, #{generationToken} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), version = IF( source_state_hash = VALUES(source_state_hash) AND priority = VALUES(priority) AND priority_rank = VALUES(priority_rank) AND rank_value = VALUES(rank_value) AND resolved_at IS NULL, version, version + 1), subject_label = VALUES(subject_label), priority = VALUES(priority), priority_rank = VALUES(priority_rank), rank_value = VALUES(rank_value), evidence_json = VALUES(evidence_json), rank_explanation_json = VALUES(rank_explanation_json), evidence_as_of = VALUES(evidence_as_of), source_state_hash = VALUES(source_state_hash), generation_token = VALUES(generation_token), resolved_at = NULL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM relationship_signal s LEFT JOIN relationship_signal_state st ON st.workspace_id = s.workspace_id AND st.signal_id = s.id AND st.user_id = #{userId} WHERE s.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND s.resolved_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.priority_rank, s.rank_value DESC, s.family, s.subject_type, s.subject_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO relationship_signal_family_state ( workspace_id, family, status, last_attempt_at, last_success_at, evidence_as_of, error_code ) VALUES ( #{workspaceId}, #{family}, 'available', #{attemptedAt}, #{attemptedAt}, #{evidenceAsOf}, NULL ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'available', last_attempt_at = VALUES(last_attempt_at), last_success_at = VALUES(last_success_at), evidence_as_of = VALUES(evidence_as_of), error_code = NULL
mapper.select: SELECT workspace_id, family, status, last_attempt_at, last_success_at, evidence_as_of, error_code FROM relationship_signal_family_state WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND family = #{family} FOR UPDATE
SELECT workspace_id, family, status, last_attempt_at, last_success_at, evidence_as_of, error_code FROM relationship_signal_family_state WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY family
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM relationship_signal_state WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId}
